lanes.name: Events / Triggers
lanes.hint: Journey entry points across all Fibre and FWA use cases

lanes.name: Retail Agent / CRM

lanes.name: RFS Portal

lanes.name: UIM / Inventory

lanes.name: Field Workforce Management

lanes.name: Billing System

phases: New Location WFM & Old Device Handling (#21)

nodes.label: Journey Entry
nodes.desc: Retail Agent initiates a Fibre/FWA use case (Activation, Instant Activation, Migration, Home Move, Port In, Port Out, Termination, or RFS data feed).

nodes.label: Journey and Session Management
nodes.desc: Reuses JSM capability from Mobile Post Paid Journey (MOB_POST_ACT_RETL_001) — queue, ticketing, tracking record creation, draft resume.

nodes.label: Customer Identification and Verification
nodes.desc: Reuses KYC capability from Mobile Post Paid Journey — identity scan, MOI validation, field comparison.

nodes.label: MOI Validation
nodes.desc: Ministry of Interior government identity validation and demographic attribute return.

nodes.label: Customer and Account Management
nodes.desc: Reuses CAM capability from Mobile Post Paid Journey — contact model, existing customer matching, account creation.

nodes.label: Capture Installation Address
nodes.desc: Retail Agent captures installation address from utility identifier or cascading zone/street/building/floor/flat search.

nodes.label: Service Availability Search
nodes.desc: RFS Portal search by address, utility identifier or area; returns service types (Fibre, FWA Indoor, FWA Outdoor) and detected CPE/ONT.

nodes.label: Address Auto-fill & Lock
nodes.desc: Address auto-filled from RFS data by utility identifier; address locked non-editable after the RFS check.

nodes.label: Proof of Address Upload
nodes.desc: Retail Agent uploads tenancy document (PDF/DOC, max 2MB).

nodes.label: Eligibility and Credit Control
nodes.desc: Reuses ECC capability from Mobile Post Paid Journey — blacklist, collections, outstanding dues, credit limit authority.

nodes.label: Connection Type Eligible?
nodes.desc: Journey proceeds only for a Qatar identity document holder taking a postpaid connection.

nodes.label: Eligibility Failure Message
nodes.desc: Distinct validation message displayed per eligibility failure so the agent can communicate the reason to the customer; journey halts here for this attempt.

nodes.label: Milestone: Contact Created & Offer Eligibility Captured
nodes.desc: First milestone — Customer Contact created & Product Offer Eligibility captured.

nodes.label: Billing Account Management
nodes.desc: Reuses BAM capability from Mobile Post Paid Journey — billing account, payment profile, bill cycle (postpaid only).

nodes.label: Milestone: Bill Profile Created (Post-paid)
nodes.desc: Second milestone — Customer Bill Profile created, applicable to postpaid only.

nodes.label: Product Selection
nodes.desc: Eligible fibre base plans displayed; IPTV bundled by default (removable); only mapped add-ons/discounts selectable; cart price recalculated on every change.

nodes.label: Number Selection
nodes.desc: Fixed line number search/select from free number list (FLN); mobile number selection for FWA; star numbers prohibited for FWA; number and charges reviewed before confirmation.

nodes.label: SIM & CPE Selection (FWA only)
nodes.desc: SIM serial scan added to cart and CPE serial scan added to cart, only for FWA Indoor or FWA Outdoor journeys.

nodes.label: Number/SIM/CPE Reservation
nodes.desc: UIM reserves and manages the fixed line/mobile number and SIM/equipment inventory; reservation completes independently and does not block the cart flow onward.

nodes.label: Appointment Slot Selection
nodes.desc: Available appointment slots fetched from WFM with lead time and technician availability; agent selects slot; customer may request a specific date/time.

nodes.label: Fetch/Book Appointment
nodes.desc: Field Workforce Management returns available slots and receives the booked appointment with notes and collection flags.

nodes.label: Appointment Applicability
nodes.desc: Appointment booking is skippable for FWA Indoor and mandatory for FWA Outdoor.

nodes.label: Workforce Task Execution
nodes.desc: ONT/STB serial capture, mesh device quantity with complimentary allowance of two, indoor and outdoor CPE serials captured for FWA Outdoor.

nodes.label: Workforce Task Closure
nodes.desc: WFM task closure required, including captured customer feedback, before the order proceeds.

nodes.label: Fault Ticket on Technician Issue
nodes.desc: Fault ticket created where the technician reports an issue during activation; WFM task updated on ticket closure; appointment may be rebooked.

nodes.label: Cart Validation & Check Out
nodes.desc: Reuses CVC capability from Mobile Post Paid Journey — pre-payment validation gate, eligibility/compatibility/cardinality checks, payment summary display.

nodes.label: Milestone: Cart Checked Out
nodes.desc: Third milestone — Cart Checked Out.

nodes.label: Contract and Documentation (CAF)
nodes.desc: Reuses CAF capability from Mobile Post Paid Journey — key information display, CAF template selection and generation.

nodes.label: CAF Signature Capture
nodes.desc: Offline signed CAF upload (PDF/JPEG, max 2MB) or digital touch-screen signature capture within the online form.

nodes.label: CAF Skip by Role?
nodes.desc: CAF submission step may be skipped by an agent holding the fulfilment role.

nodes.label: Additional Documents & Activity Comments
nodes.desc: Additional/supporting documents uploaded to a separate section; activity comments captured and passed to the WFM task.

nodes.label: Milestone: Signed CAF
nodes.desc: Fourth milestone — Signed CAF.

nodes.label: Payment and Inventory
nodes.desc: Reuses PAY capability from Mobile Post Paid Journey — payment summary, upfront charge/deposit, WinCash handling, receipt issuance.

nodes.label: Inventory Depletion
nodes.desc: Fixed line number inventory depleted in UIM as part of Fulfilment; SIM/CPE inventory depleted to POS payment system on payment completion for FWA.

nodes.label: Order Submission
nodes.desc: Retail Agent submits the order once all sections are filled and saved and payment has completed.

nodes.label: Milestone: Order Submitted
nodes.desc: Final milestone — Order Submitted.

nodes.label: Order Submission (Fulfilment)
nodes.desc: Reuses ORD capability from Mobile Post Paid Journey — order routing to fulfilment, Customer 360 order views, tracking record lifecycle.

nodes.label: Notification and Feedback
nodes.desc: Reuses NOT capability — order submission, failure and completion notification to all MSISDNs on the QID; feedback survey despatch (WFM feedback handled separately at WFM).

nodes.label: End of Order Capture Journey
nodes.desc: Order capture journey complete; hands off to Order-Management-orchestrated fixed line activation.

nodes.label: Network Activation — Fibre
nodes.desc: Order Management triggers network activation on completion of the WFM task for a fibre journey; status updated to CRM.

nodes.label: Network Activation — FWA Indoor
nodes.desc: Network activation proceeds on the planned activation date without waiting for a WFM task, for FWA Indoor.

nodes.label: SIM Activation with Network
nodes.desc: SIM activated together with network activation for an FWA journey.

nodes.label: Order Status to Workforce
nodes.desc: Order status updated to WFM so the technician may proceed with order activation.

nodes.label: Billing Update After Fulfilment
nodes.desc: Account, product, service and resource information (with prices) passed to billing after WFM task closure; additional device billing; FWA Indoor CPE billed at order capture.

nodes.label: Order Completion
nodes.desc: Order completion notification received from Order Management into CRM.

nodes.label: Tracking Record Resolved
nodes.desc: Tracking record set to resolved once the order is completed; order number recorded.

nodes.label: Instant Activation Eligibility Detection
nodes.desc: RFS response detects whether a reusable pre-installed device exists at the location and is eligible for instant activation.

nodes.label: Device Serial Verification
nodes.desc: Retail Agent verifies the detected device serial number against the physical device before instant activation proceeds.

nodes.label: Field Agent Tablet Constraint
nodes.desc: Instant activation available only to field agents on a tablet device; physical device verification not supported on desktop-only agent — this constraint is a fixed channel boundary, not a further process step.

nodes.label: Instant or Normal Activation?
nodes.desc: Agent selects explicitly between instant and normal activation, defaulting to normal where instant is not selected.

nodes.label: Appointment Auto-skip
nodes.desc: Appointment booking automatically skipped for instant activation, while retaining flexibility for the agent to book on customer request.

nodes.label: Immediate Activation Trigger
nodes.desc: Immediate network activation flow triggered on order submission for an instant activation journey; agent notified of the activation outcome.

nodes.label: Instant Activation Failure Handling
nodes.desc: Support request raised and a technician visit arranged where the service does not work following instant activation.

nodes.label: Migration Eligibility Validation
nodes.desc: Migration allowed only for active FWA Indoor/Outdoor services with no open fulfilment, termination, portability or home-move orders.

nodes.label: Customer Verification
nodes.desc: Customer identity verification required before initiation of migration.

nodes.label: Service Availability Validation
nodes.desc: Fibre availability at the target installation address validated before migration order creation.

nodes.label: Existing Service Retrieval
nodes.desc: Existing service, equipment, MSISDN, SIM and billing information retrieved from the active FWA subscription.

nodes.label: Migration Order Capture
nodes.desc: Migration order, customer contact preference, language, alternate number captured.

nodes.label: Installation Appointment Creation
nodes.desc: Fibre installation appointment created through WFM.

nodes.label: Telesales Request Flag
nodes.desc: CAF and tenancy document collection automatically flagged for telephone-originated migration requests; a configuration flag, not a further process step.

nodes.label: Outdoor Device Recovery Appointment
nodes.desc: Device recovery appointment created when migrating from FWA Outdoor to Fibre.

nodes.label: Existing Service Continuity
nodes.desc: Existing FWA service kept active until the Fibre installation is successfully completed.

nodes.label: Fibre Activation Trigger
nodes.desc: Fibre activation triggered only after successful installation closure from WFM.

nodes.label: SIM Deactivation
nodes.desc: FWA SIM deactivated only after successful Fibre activation.

nodes.label: Migration Failure Handling
nodes.desc: FWA service retained and a support ticket raised when Fibre installation or activation fails.

nodes.label: Resource Release
nodes.desc: FWA-specific resources, SIM inventory and associated network resources released following successful migration.

nodes.label: Billing Migration
nodes.desc: FWA recurring charges terminated and Fibre recurring charges activated on the migration completion date.

nodes.label: Customer Notification
nodes.desc: Customer notified at migration request creation, appointment booking, activation success and failure events.

nodes.label: Home Move Request Creation
nodes.desc: Request created through the retail store queue, or by a support agent to the fibre fulfilment team queue where the customer calls.

nodes.label: New Installation Address Capture
nodes.desc: New installation address captured for the home move; service availability checked for the new location.

nodes.label: New Location Installation Appointment
nodes.desc: Follows the same WFM capability as Fiber Activation Journey (FAR).

nodes.label: Fixed Line Number Retention
nodes.desc: New fixed line number selection not permitted; existing number retained.

nodes.label: WFM Task Execution at New Location
nodes.desc: Follows the same WFM capability as Fiber Activation Journey (FAR).

nodes.label: Old Location Fibre Device Retention
nodes.desc: No uninstallation appointment captured for a fibre-to-fibre home move; fibre device retained at the old location.

nodes.label: Old Location Outdoor Device Uninstallation
nodes.desc: Uninstallation appointment captured for an FWA Outdoor device at the old location for a move originating from FWA Outdoor.

nodes.label: FWA Equipment Carried by Customer
nodes.desc: Recorded that FWA CPE is carried by the customer to the new location where the move is to an FWA service area.

nodes.label: Service Termination at Old Location
nodes.desc: All services at the old location terminated on the confirmed move date.

nodes.label: Inventory Release at Old Location
nodes.desc: CPE and IP address at the old location released on the confirmed move date.

nodes.label: Move Date Billing Update
nodes.desc: Billing update triggered on the move date with the new plan/resources at the new location; billing for terminated old-location services updated.

nodes.label: Ported Number Capture
nodes.desc: Retail Agent captures the fixed line number being ported in; new fixed line number selection not permitted.

nodes.label: Portability Identifier at Appointment
nodes.desc: Portability identifier required to be marked by the Retail Agent during appointment booking.

nodes.label: Portability Appointment Date
nodes.desc: Portability appointment date set where the portability identifier is marked by the Retail Agent.

nodes.label: Portability Form Submission
nodes.desc: Retail Agent completes and submits the portability form; customer signs; signed form uploaded.

nodes.label: Portability Request Creation
nodes.desc: Portability request created from the Portability Identifier and submitted to NPAS.

nodes.label: Portability Request Confirmation
nodes.desc: Update received on the portability request from NPAS after approval by the Donor Service Provider.

nodes.label: Portability WFM Appointment Execution
nodes.desc: WFM task for FLN change triggered based on confirmed Port In date received on or before the captured portability appointment date.

nodes.label: Portability Activation After Completion
nodes.desc: Ported fixed line number activated after portability completion and configured during the WFM task, with no temporary number provided.

nodes.label: Port Out Trouble Ticket Creation
nodes.desc: Trouble ticket automatically created in CRM on receipt of a port out request from NPAS.

nodes.label: Port Out Queue Assignment
nodes.desc: Ticket automatically assigned to the portability queue; initial validation service level timer triggered.

nodes.label: Port Out Document Validation
nodes.desc: Agent validates the portability form and identity document received from NPAS; documents uploaded to the ticket.

nodes.label: Mandatory and Form Checks
nodes.desc: Portability form date validated within the allowed period; customer name, ID number and service type confirmed against system records.

nodes.label: Outstanding Bill?
nodes.desc: Request moved to conditionally accepted where the customer holds a pending bill; customer given a defined window to clear dues.

nodes.label: Service Level Extension
nodes.desc: Service level timer extended from the initial period to the final action period where the documents are valid.

nodes.label: Automatic Processing on SLA Breach
nodes.desc: Request automatically processed in accordance with the configured rule where no action is taken within the service level.

nodes.label: Status Communication to NPAS
nodes.desc: Every accept, reject and conditional acceptance action communicated back to NPAS using the defined status codes.

nodes.label: Port Out Termination Order
nodes.desc: Agent generates a termination order from the port out ticket on ticket closure, linked to the ticket, with termination wish date set to the confirmed portability date.

nodes.label: Port Out Network Deactivation
nodes.desc: Services deactivated on the confirmed portability date; one-hour window provided for activation towards the new service provider.

nodes.label: Port Out Inventory Quarantine
nodes.desc: Ported inventory marked to quarantine for the configured period; SIM deactivated and released for FWA.

nodes.label: Termination Request Initiation
nodes.desc: Retail Agent or Retention Agent initiates a termination request from Customer 360 for an active Fibre or FWA service.

nodes.label: Customer and Service Eligibility Validation
nodes.desc: Customer identity, service status, open orders, active disputes, fraud/legal blocks and pending termination requests validated before proceeding.

nodes.label: Retention Handling
nodes.desc: Termination request routed to the retention process where required; retention outcome captured before termination order creation.

nodes.label: Outstanding Dues Validation
nodes.desc: Outstanding balance retrieved; termination prevented or conditionally allowed based on the configured VFQ settlement rule.

nodes.label: Penalty Charge Display
nodes.desc: Applicable early termination or lock-in penalty calculated and displayed before termination confirmation.

nodes.label: Equipment Recovery Appointment
nodes.desc: WFM appointment triggered or allowed for equipment recovery where service type and device ownership rules require it, including FWA Outdoor device recovery.

nodes.label: Termination Order Capture
nodes.desc: Termination reason and requested termination date captured before submitting the termination order, along with appointment and payment details.

nodes.label: Termination Order Submission
nodes.desc: Termination order created and submitted to Order Management after all mandatory validations, consent and recovery requirements are satisfied.

nodes.label: Network Deactivation
nodes.desc: Fixed/FWA service deactivated on the confirmed termination date; deactivation outcome returned to CRM.

nodes.label: Billing Closure
nodes.desc: Billing updated after termination, including final charges, penalty, refund/credit where applicable and service closure status.

nodes.label: Inventory Release
nodes.desc: Fixed line number, CPE, ONT, FWA SIM/equipment and IP resources released based on service type and configured release/quarantine rules.

nodes.label: Customer Notification
nodes.desc: Customer notified on termination request creation, order submission, appointment where applicable, and completion/failure.

nodes.label: Termination Inventory Quarantine
nodes.desc: Ported inventory marked to quarantine for the configured period; SIM deactivated and released for FWA.

nodes.label: Trigger: Go To Market File Received
GTM File Pickup and Transformation
nodes.desc: Go To Market file picked up through the mediation layer; data filtered and transformed into system-specific formats for each downstream system.

nodes.label: Data Distribution to Downstream Systems
nodes.desc: Processed data distributed to UIM, the RFS Portal, CRM and the analytics data warehouse.

nodes.label: Vodafone Identifier Generation and Mapping
nodes.desc: Operator identifier (VFID) generated and mapped to the utility identifier through field survey, supporting one-to-one and one-to-many relationships.

nodes.label: Ready For Service Status Update
nodes.desc: Building marked ready for service once ready for provisioning; applicable service level category recorded.

nodes.label: Ready For Service Portal Search
nodes.desc: Sales team searches the RFS Portal by address, utility identifier or area.

nodes.label: Recommendation Integration
nodes.desc: Offer recommendations received from the big data system into the RFS Portal.

nodes.label: Lead Creation from Portal
nodes.desc: Sales agent creates a lead in CRM from the RFS Portal using the customer mobile number.

nodes.label: Continuous RFS Update
nodes.desc: RFS data updated through subsequent GTM file loads and through manual updates from the business.
